upgrade.rule: upgrade (both directions of) the core link that is the worst link in the most N-1 link-failure cases

upgrade_alt.rule: upgrade (both directions of) the most loaded link in the worst N-1 case

upgrade_search.rule: every core link pair x ASSUMED sizes (2x, 4x current) against no failure + every N-1 link and router case; ranked by worst-case utilisation reduction (pp) per Gbit/s added per direction
upgrade_search.label: added after seeing results (search replaces the two fixed rules as the planning answer; both rules kept)
